caption:
The wind drops in June and the Sea of Cortez transforms.

Flat water. Visibility pushing 50 feet. Whale sharks drifting near Espiritu Santo. Sea lions at Los Islotes doing barrel rolls through the shallows. Manta rays at Cerralvo. Jacques Cousteau called this the world's aquarium — and every dive proves him right.

The Moroccan Palace sits five minutes from the water. Pool in the morning. Sea of Cortez in the afternoon. Rooftop sky bed under a desert full of stars at night.

Book your summer stay at themoroccanpalace.com
